facts.fact: Agence Ecofin refers in the past tense to the Agenda national de transition numérique 2022-2025, whose stated period had ended by the article's date of 2026-06-30; the article does not say a successor exists.

Agence Ecofin says the Agenda national de transition numérique 2022-2025 set an objective of raising the digital sector's value added to about 700 million dollars, nearly 8% of Mauritanian GDP; the article gives no date for the target beyond the agenda's period, and the published date 2026-06-30 is used.

systems.tiers: national; still being deployed per the article, with a national CERT/CSIRT planned

systems.country_label: Programme régional d'intégration numérique en Afrique de l'Ouest (WARDIP)

note: The article does not describe the agenda's scope, so class is left empty; the period and target facts are recorded with class empty.
